title: The Suite Spot – Budget-Friendly & Fully Equipped
description:
This is a one bedroom mother-in-law suite on the ground level of a single family home. Centrally located, this is the perfect place for one or two travelers. 
Broadway: 13 miles
Franklin: 6 miles
Leipers Fork: 11 miles
Nearest Coffee Shop: 1/2 a mile. 

Features to Note: 
* Guests enter through red door into a hallway. The door to the suite is on the left at the end of the hallway & has its own lock & code. 
*Living room
*Kitchenette
*Washer and Dryer
* Queen bedroom with ensuite bathroom.

The space
It is important for guests to note the follow:
*This is a mother-in-law-suite attached to a single family home. 
*Guests have their own space, except for a shared hallway that leads to the unit. 
*There is a cat at the property that will get into the main house through the shared hallway. 
*The suite has a kitchenette with a Keurig coffee maker, hot plate, and toaster oven to do some basic cooking.

Guest access
Guests have full access to their suite, it is a private unit that only shares a hallway to the unit. The family that lives upstairs is very quiet and only has adult children.
